title: RememberGraphInput
description: GAP-SG-216: JSON object accepted by `sqlite-graphrag remember --graph-stdin` and `remember --graph-file`. Until v1.2.8 this wire shape had no published schema, so the commonest failure — a missing `entity_type` — could only be discovered by triggering it. Also since v1.2.8 the `entity_type` vocabulary is OPEN: a label outside the thirteen recommended kinds is stored as written instead of being replaced. Every member is optional: `body` is used only when no other body source is given, and an empty `entities` with `--replace-graph` is how bindings are cleared.

body.description: Memory body. Ignored when --body, --body-file or --body-stdin supplied one; those win and only entities/relationships are taken from here.

entities.description: Graph entities to bind to this memory. Bounded by the XDG key limits.max_entities_per_memory (default 50).

name.description: Canonical entity name within the namespace, kebab-case.

entity_type.description: Semantic type of the graph NODE. The vocabulary is OPEN since v1.2.8 (GAP-SG-277, GAP-SG-278): any term is accepted and STORED AS WRITTEN, never replaced by another label. Thirteen kinds stay RECOMMENDED — concept, dashboard, date, decision, file, incident, issue_tracker, location, memory, organization, person, project, tool — and a label outside them is reported in the response `warnings` array while still being written. Pass `--strict-entity-types` to restrict the write to those thirteen and be refused with exit 1 otherwise. Only the SHAPE is enforced: the label is trimmed, lowercased and has hyphens turned into underscores, and it is rejected when empty, digits only, containing a line break, or longer than 64 characters. This is NOT the memory --type, which is a different CLOSED vocabulary (user, feedback, project, reference, decision, incident, skill, document, note) with a different meaning; `project`, `decision` and `incident` appear in both and mean different things. When no type is declared at all, the entity is stored as `concept`.

type.description: Alias accepted by the parser as a synonym for `entity_type`. Same open vocabulary and same shape rules.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the entity.

relationships.description: Graph edges to bind to this memory. Bounded by the XDG key limits.max_relations_per_memory (default 50).

relation.description: Relation label. The 12 canonical values are applies-to, uses, depends-on, causes, fixes, contradicts, supports, follows, related, mentions, replaces, tracked-in. Any kebab-case or snake_case string is accepted and normalized to snake_case before storage.

strength.description: Edge strength in [0.0, 1.0]. Defaults to 0.5 when omitted (GAP-CLI-GRAPH-01). Exposed as `weight` in graph outputs.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the relationship.
